title: Let the seat store change maps without its callers noticing

cases.says: holding, replacing, looking up, releasing and listing seats give the same results over a HashMap, a TreeMap and a ConcurrentHashMap
a hold with no guest throws NullPointerException over every map, including one that would store a null, and changes nothing
asking who holds a null seat throws NullPointerException over every map, including one that would answer it
the list of holds is a copy: walking it while the store changes neither throws nor shows the changes, over every map

origin.section: The Swap Is Free Only for What the Wrapper Promises: HashMap Accepted null, ConcurrentHashMap Throws
